key_points: NVIDIA authorized a $150B share repurchase, raising total buyback authorization to $235B.
Morgan Stanley reiterated NVDA as its top pick citing attractive valuation.
High-profile investors (Cathie Wood) added to positions, while Dan Loeb’s Third Point exited some semiconductor holdings.
Michael Burry bought put options on NVDA, signaling hedging/bearish view.
Retail and institutional flow shows mixed buying (Meeder Advisory) and selling (Artemis Wealth).
